# External contract fixtures

Only synthetic or vendor-public fields are allowed here. Account identifiers, request headers, cookies, quotas and credentials are forbidden.

The Coinglass feature-source matrix is intentionally fail-closed: rows remain `UNKNOWN` and `automatic_feature_eligible=false` until field semantics, entitlement, retention/redistribution rights and sanitized captured fixtures are approved. Unit tests use in-memory synthetic responses; they are not represented as captured vendor fixtures.
